title: Pt–Y supported on magnesium–aluminium composite oxide catalysts for highly selective synthesis of 1,2-pentanediol from furfuryl alcohol under mild conditions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23314-23325
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02263D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiaodong Zhou, Fengqin Guo, Ziqiang Han, Jiajun Zhang, Yan Cao, Huiquan Li, Guozhu Chen, Liguo Wang
The MgO–AlO(OH) composite supporter anchors Pt–Y bimetallic clusters, which catalyze the hydrogenolysis of furfuryl alcohol to synthesize 1,2-pentanediol under mild conditions with high selectivity.
